beats.summary: Jim proposes celebrating all birthdays at once to save time and effort.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So… I think, yeah, I think getting these out of the way might be productive.
Jim: We can just have one big fun party. Everybody's happy, nobody wastes their time.

beats.summary: Angela expresses disapproval of Jim's idea to combine birthday celebrations.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Wow! You're shaking things up a bit, huh?

beats.summary: Michael is led blindfolded by Dwight into the forest to begin a survival challenge.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Here we go, into the wild. Mighty forest. Can you smell the trees and the nature?

beats.summary: Michael prepares for survival by fashioning clothing and tools from his own clothes.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I'm going to wear what was once one of my pant legs.

beats.summary: Jim negotiates birthday cake preferences with Meredith and Creed.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: I really prefer devils food cake.
Creed: Today is actually my birthday and I want to pick the cake.

beats.summary: Dwight secretly stays close to Michael during his survival challenge to provide unseen moral support.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I lied to Michael. I said that I would leave him alone, but I will not.
